name: .gitignore Generator
description: Combine offline language, framework, editor and OS templates into a clearly organized .gitignore, with safe deduplication and custom rules
help: Search and select templates, then adjust their order. An optional existing .gitignore goes first; your custom rules go last. Everything is generated locally without network access.
Templates are bundled from a pinned github/gitignore snapshot under CC0 1.0. Source details and the complete license are available from the template library footer.

Repeated positive rules are removed only when safe. Negation rules beginning with !, escapes, spaces and rule order are preserved, so some repeated rules deliberately remain. Later rules can override earlier ones.
Copy the preview or save it as .gitignore with LF or CRLF line endings. No project files are changed until you choose where to save. This tool generates rules; it does not scan your workspace.

Create reusable custom templates from the template library. Name and edit their rules, then save to keep them across restarts in ToolForge's existing local storage. Deleting a template also removes it from the current selection.
